subject: Security features queue: CMK rotation windows + audit snapshot prioritization
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security features queue: CMK rotation windows + audit snapshot prioritization

Team —

CareBridge (HS-12478) pushed a short list of compliance asks during legal review that we need to triage for product roadmap and for their procurement window. High level:

- Per-tenant key rotation window policy (they want the ability to set a rotation cadence and also a retained-previous-key export for forensic queries)
- One-click audit snapshot export (signed, timebound export of last N days of audit logs + SSO session map)
- Short-term retention carveouts for SSO session mappings (customer wants 180 days as baseline)

I attached the evidence request they sent. Can each of you weigh in on feasibility, dependencies, and a rough timeline? Proposed owners: Ben (security) for KMS/rotation and export signatures, Marissa (ops) for export pipeline and storage, Soojin (prod) to prioritize and shape requirements. Kimberly — legal/regulatory needs to confirm if signed export format is acceptable.

Please reply with: 1) blockers, 2) rough estimate (sprints), 3) any alternative we should offer as a fall-back. I want to get a customer-facing answer by EOW.

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: carebridge-evidence-request.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security features queue: CMK rotation windows + audit snapshot prioritization

Jonas / team —

Thanks for surfacing. Quick notes from a security/engineering feasibility POV:

1) CMK rotation windows
- We can support per-tenant rotation cadence (policy stored in customer metadata + schedule). The tricky part is "retained-previous-key export": we cannot give raw KMS keys, but we can produce a signed key-derivation artifact or a key-usage ledger that proves which key version was used for tokens/timestamps.
- Dependency: KMS integration layer must be extended to record key version metadata and export an auditable bundle. Work + review: ~2 sprints (security + infra) to implement a sealed export format and another sprint for legal review of export semantics.

2) Audit snapshot export (signed)
- We can build an export path (ndjson.gz) that includes audit events, SSO session map, and request traces for window X. Signing can be done with a service-level signing key; customers can request a signed artifact. We need to add two things: a snapshot job and a signing/verification flow.
- Dependencies: storage (S3), export orchestration, signing oracle (HSM/KMS path). Estimated effort: 3 sprints for a minimal, secure implementation. If we add per-tenant encryption of exported bundle with customer-managed keys, add +1 sprint.

3) SSO session mapping retention
- Session mapping is cheap to index but we need a TTL policy and a retention enforcement job; might conflict with ephemeral KV caches. Estimate: 1 sprint.

Blockers / considerations:
- If the customer requires exported bundles encrypted with their CMK, that's additional KMS work and legal approval.
- We must define SLA for export generation (e.g., 48h turnaround) and storage lifecycle.

Attachments: brief notes on KMS rotation semantics attached.

Ben
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: kms-rotation-note.md)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, katie@carebridge.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security features queue: CMK rotation windows + audit snapshot prioritization

Thanks Ben — helpful breakdown.

Proposal to triage:
- Priority A: Audit snapshot export (signed) — required for their procurement. Aim: MVP export that includes audit events + SSO map, signed by our service key.
- Priority B: SSO session mapping TTL (180d baseline) — low engineering risk, good customer delight win.
- Priority C: CMK rotation/export semantics — important but higher risk due to legal constraints around key material.

Ben / Marissa: can you provide a narrower engineering estimate (point-style) for the MVP export (A) and TTL policy (B)? Also call out if the export MVP can be delivered without per-tenant CMK encryption.

Kimberly — can legal confirm whether a service-signed export is sufficient for their auditors or if they require customer-held encryption on the export?

Katie (CareBridge) — looping you in so expectations are transparent. We want to give a clear timeline.

Soojin
Product Manager, Security Features
Redwood Inference

From: Katie Sanchez <katie@carebridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security features queue: CMK rotation windows + audit snapshot prioritization

Thanks for the quick loop-in. A few clarifications from CareBridge security/legal:

- For the audit export we need the ability to receive a signed bundle that proves authenticity and integrity (timestamped). Service signing is acceptable, provided the bundle includes a verification path and we can validate signature.
- Retention: we are asking for 180 days of SSO/session mapping data to be retained for regulatory audits; if longer is required we will flag separately.
- CMK: we do not expect raw key material. Our ask is that you provide per-tenant rotation policy and an auditable record of key versions and key-usage. If you support export encryption using our CMK in the future that is a plus but not required for now.

Contact for audits: audits@carebridge.com if you need sample formats or legal templates.

Katie Sanchez
Director, Security & Compliance
CareBridge Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, katie@carebridge.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security features queue: CMK rotation windows + audit snapshot prioritization

Team —

Operational notes and timeline constraints:

- Export pipeline: we need an export orchestration job that can assemble events (audit logs + SSO map) for the requested window, produce a gzipped ndjson bundle, sign it, and stage to an S3 bucket for customer retrieval. Implementation touches: write pipeline, export scheduler, storage lifecycle, permissions.
- Estimated effort for MVP (Priority A + B): ~3 sprints (6 weeks) if security sign-off is available and we can re-use existing signing key flow. That estimate assumes no per-tenant encryption.
- If customer requires per-tenant CMK encryption of the bundle, add 2 weeks to integrate KMS-encrypt-on-export and legal review.
- Blockers: infra budget to host exported bundles beyond retention window, and a small audit of our signing key process (HSM path).

Can we commit to a pilot timeline: start work in mid-Dec sprint, target internal canary in late Jan, customer pilot early Feb? If yes, Ben and infra should confirm resource availability.

(attachment: export-s3-spec.pdf)

Marissa
Senior Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, katie@carebridge.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security features queue: CMK rotation windows + audit snapshot prioritization

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick summary and actions so we have a single source of truth:

Decisions
- Ship Priority A (signed audit snapshot export MVP) as a customer-facing feature; service-signed artifact is acceptable for CareBridge.
- Ship Priority B (SSO session mapping TTL = 180 days) alongside export as a low-risk tweak.
- Defer full per-tenant CMK-encrypted export to Q2 as a follow-up (dependent on infra budget and legal template).

Owners & next steps
- Ben: own security sign-off and sealed export format definition. Deliverable: spec doc + acceptance criteria by 2026-12-10.
- Marissa: own export pipeline implementation plan and infra cost estimate. Deliverable: plan + budget estimate by 2026-12-15.
- Soojin: produce a short customer-facing timeline and runbook for the CareBridge pilot. Deliverable: external message draft by 2026-12-11.
- Kimberly: confirm that service-signed bundle is OK and provide any contract language needed by 2026-12-12.

Jonas
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
